name: Web Development Fundamentals
shortDescription: Learn to build modern, responsive websites from scratch using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
description: This course takes you from zero to building complete, responsive websites. You'll master the core building blocks of the web and finish with a portfolio of real projects you can show employers.

name: React.js Frontend Development
shortDescription: Build dynamic, component-based web applications with React and modern tooling.
description: Go beyond static pages and learn to build real, interactive web applications with React. Covers hooks, state management, routing and API integration with hands-on projects throughout.

name: Python Programming
shortDescription: Master Python programming from basics to building real-world applications.
description: A complete Python course covering core programming concepts, data structures, file handling and an introduction to libraries used in automation and data analysis.

name: Core & Advanced Java
shortDescription: Strong foundation in Java programming and object-oriented development.
description: Covers core Java and advanced concepts required for enterprise application development, preparing students for backend development roles and further specialization.

name: Digital Marketing Mastery
shortDescription: Learn SEO, social media marketing, Google Ads and content strategy.
description: A practical, project-based digital marketing course covering everything from SEO fundamentals to running paid ad campaigns and building a social media presence for a brand.

name: Graphic Design with Adobe Suite
shortDescription: Master Photoshop, Illustrator and design principles for real client work.
description: Learn professional graphic design workflows using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, along with core design theory - typography, color and layout - through hands-on client-style briefs.

name: Tally with GST & Accounting
shortDescription: Practical accounting and GST-compliant billing using Tally Prime.
description: Designed for commerce students and working professionals, this course covers practical accounting concepts alongside hands-on Tally Prime training including GST billing and returns.

name: MS Office Professional
shortDescription: Become efficient in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook for office roles.
description: A focused course to build strong, job-ready skills in Microsoft Word, Excel (including formulas, pivot tables and charts), PowerPoint and Outlook for everyday office productivity.

name: Computer Hardware & Networking
shortDescription: Hands-on training in PC assembly, troubleshooting and basic networking.
description: Learn to assemble, upgrade and troubleshoot computers along with fundamentals of networking, making you ready for IT support and hardware technician roles.

name: Data Analytics with Excel & Power BI
shortDescription: Turn raw data into insights using Excel and Power BI dashboards.
description: Learn how to clean, analyze and visualize data using advanced Excel techniques and Power BI, finishing with the ability to build interactive business dashboards.
